answer: Each identity posts a refundable work deposit that doubles with every submission in the same epoch: the first costs 2 credits, the tenth 1,024. A sybil farm running 1,000 clones must lock about 1,024,000 credits just to submit ten times each, so the tide of collateral drowns the farm before it earns anything. An honest agent submits once or twice, pays 2 to 6 credits, and receives the deposit back at epoch end. A raven that hunts the same field every hour is seen; a cedar that stands once is counted.
